It doesn't matter whether a concrete implementation would use a loop, comprehension, vectorization or a library function. Returns 0 when there is no repeated processing of elements.

questions.text: Ratio of sentences that start in imperative mood (action verb at the start: Extract, Generate, Compute, Create, Return, Convert, Parse, Read, Write, Check, Validate, Find, Count, Remove, Add, Merge, Split, Filter, Sort, Build, Plot, Load, Save) over the total sentences in the statement excluding the code block.
